description: This Java source file implements the ReadReportingService interface, providing methods for retrieving report data, generating reports in CSV and PDF formats, and managing report metadata within the Apache Fineract project. It interacts with the database via JDBC, handles report SQL queries, and supports report rendering.

classes.name: ReadReportingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of report retrieval and export services within the Fineract platform, including CSV and PDF generation, metadata retrieval, and SQL query management.

methods.name: retrieveReportCSV
methods.description: Generates a CSV report as a StreamingOutput response given report parameters.

methods.name: retrieveGenericResultset
methods.description: Retrieves report data as a generic result set based on report name, type, and query parameters.

methods.name: getSQLtoRun
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string to execute for a given report, applying query parameters and user-specific constraints.

methods.name: getSql
methods.description: Fetches the report SQL stored in the database based on report name and type, with security validations.

methods.name: getQuotedTableName
methods.description: Returns a safely quoted table name for SQL queries, based on report type.

methods.name: getQuotedColumnName
methods.description: Constructs a safely quoted column name using report type and suffix.

methods.name: retrieveReportPDF
methods.description: Generates a PDF report file from report data, saved to filesystem, based on report parameters.

methods.name: retrieveReport
methods.description: Retrieves a report metadata object by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveReportList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all available reports.

methods.name: retrieveReports
methods.description: Helper method to fetch report data and parameters, optionally filtered by report ID.

methods.name: getAllowedParameters
methods.description: Returns a collection of allowed report parameters.

methods.name: retrieveGenericResultSetForSmsEmailCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves report data specifically formatted for SMS/email campaigns.

methods.name: sqlToRunForSmsEmailCampaign
methods.description: Prepares SQL for SMS/email campaigns with query parameters.

methods.name: generatePentahoReportAsOutputStream
methods.description: Placeholder for generating report via Pentaho, currently not implemented.
